notes.title: 【Notice of Postponement of the Release of "KAMITSUBAKI CITY UNDER CONSTRUCTION R
notes.notes:
We have decided to postpone the release date of the ADV "KAMITSUBAKI CITY UNDER CONSTRUCTION REGENERATE" scheduled for release on February 20, 2025 (Thursday), due to an extended development period for the purpose of quality improvement.

Release : March 13, 2025 (Thursday)

We apologize for the inconvenience to all observers who have been looking forward to the release, but we will do our utmost to ensure that you will be able to enjoy the story of "KAMITSUBAKI CITY UNDER CONSTRUCTION. We are doing our best to develop the story of "KAMITSUBAKI CITY UNDER CONSTRUCTION" so that you can enjoy it even more.
We appreciate your continued support.
